sources.title: Sethblocks/Neuron-Thinking-Beta · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Neuron Thinking Beta (1.2B) This is my experimental model finetuned from LFM2.5 1.2B Thinking. So far it seems to work fairly well from my own testing on some short reasoning tasks. It is fair with conversation but excels in thinking tasks far beyond the other Neuron models. An updated version is coming soon as well.

sources.snippet: The Gemini 3 and 2.5 series models use a "thinking process" that significantly improves their reasoning and multi-step planning abilities, making them highly effective for complex tasks such as coding, advanced mathematics, and data analysis.
